title: Xianziyu's Interesting Items
description: Some practical tools, including mineral-based weapons and others.
body:
## **Added some potentially interesting items.**

**Exp Totem：**

Reusable Totem of Undying. It functions as long as you still have experience points.

**Exp Remnants:**

Spawn naturally in Amethyst Geodes. Smelt and craft with Diamonds into Exp Ingots.

**Exp Armor & Equipment:**

Boosts Armor, Armor Toughness and Damage based on Experience Level.

**Sturdy Enchantments：**

Each level reduces incoming damage by 1 point. Exclusive to armor pieces.

**Limited Sword：**

Inflicts 5% of the enemy's maximum health as damage, bypassing the vast majority of defensive effects.
